select row_to_json(q)::text from (select a.*, case when d.account_id is null then false else
  exists(select 1 from transactions t where t.user_id=a.user_id and t.account_id=a.id) end as used
from accounts a left join onboarding_default_accounts d on d.user_id=a.user_id and d.account_id=a.id
where a.user_id=?
) q order by 1
select row_to_json(q)::text from (select * from investments where user_id=?) q order by 1
select row_to_json(q)::text from (select * from goals where user_id=?) q order by 1
select row_to_json(q)::text from (select a.* from goal_allocations a join goals g on g.id=a.goal_id where g.user_id=?) q order by 1

select row_to_json(q)::text from (select c.*, exists(select 1 from card_opening_batches b where b.card_id=c.id) as opened,
  (exists(select 1 from card_transactions t join invoices i on i.id=t.invoice_id where i.card_id=c.id)
   or exists(select 1 from card_payments p join invoices i on i.id=p.invoice_id where i.card_id=c.id)
   or exists(select 1 from card_refunds r where r.card_id=c.id)) as used
from credit_cards c where c.user_id=?
) q order by 1

select row_to_json(q)::text from (select i.* from invoices i join credit_cards c on c.id=i.card_id where c.user_id=?
  and (not exists(select 1 from card_transactions t where t.invoice_id=i.id)
   or exists(select 1 from card_transactions t where t.invoice_id=i.id
      and t.amount<>t.paid_amount+t.refunded_amount and (t.origin<>'LEGACY_UNKNOWN' or i.status<>'PAID')))
) q order by 1

select row_to_json(q)::text from (select t.* from card_transactions t join invoices i on i.id=t.invoice_id join credit_cards c on c.id=i.card_id
where c.user_id=? and t.amount<>t.paid_amount+t.refunded_amount
  and (t.origin<>'LEGACY_UNKNOWN' or i.status<>'PAID')
) q order by 1
select row_to_json(q)::text from (select id,type from categories where user_id=? and id=any(?)) q order by 1
select row_to_json(q)::text from (select * from onboarding_default_accounts where user_id=?) q order by 1
